_restart.label_prefix: ordinary cloud restart mode and case
_restart.label_expression: "ordinary cloud restart mode and case"
_restart.check_expression: mode=="restart_first" and OS.get_environment("CAMPAIGN_CALLBACK_CASE")==CALLBACK_CASE

_restart.label_prefix: immutable actual preceding cloud report path and SHA
_restart.label_expression: "immutable actual preceding cloud report path and SHA"
_restart.check_expression: path.is_absolute_path() and Intent.hex(digest,64) and FileAccess.file_exists(path)

_restart.label_prefix: original cloud report exact bounded UTF8 bytes
_restart.label_expression: "original cloud report exact bounded UTF8 bytes"
_restart.check_expression: not raw.is_empty() and raw.size()<=2097152 and text.to_utf8_buffer()==raw and text.sha256_text()==digest and FileAccess.get_sha256(path)==digest

_restart.label_prefix: preceding original successful cloud report
_restart.label_expression: "preceding original successful cloud report"
_restart.check_expression: prior is Dictionary and prior.get("schema")=="campaign_original19_cloud_applying_probe_v3" and prior.get("passed")==true and prior.get("failures")==[] and prior.get("case")==CALLBACK_CASE and prior.get("mode")=="first"

_restart.label_prefix: same full installed identity and raw user text in a distinct process
_restart.label_expression: "same full installed identity and raw user text in a distinct process"
_restart.check_expression: prior.get("identity")==identity and prior.get("user_directory")==OS.get_user_data_dir() and prior.get("pid")!=OS.get_process_id() and Intent.hex(prior.get("nonce",""),32) and prior.nonce!=nonce

_restart.label_prefix: original local cloud result and exact final CFG hash
_restart.label_expression: "original local cloud result and exact final CFG hash"
_restart.check_expression: evidence is Dictionary and semantic is Dictionary and evidence.get("applied")==true and evidence.get("synthetic_local_owner")==true and evidence.get("SDK_disabled")==true and evidence.get("final_memory")=={"records":{},"unlocked":2,"owner":"1"} and Intent.hex(evidence.get("cfg_sha256",""),64)

_restart.label_prefix: original whole native typed CFG projection hash
_restart.label_expression: "original whole native typed CFG projection hash"
_restart.check_expression: semantic.get("final_sections_json") is String and semantic.get("final_semantics_sha256") is String and semantic.final_sections_json.sha256_text()==semantic.final_semantics_sha256

_restart.label_prefix: original whole native projection readable
_restart.label_expression: "original whole native projection readable"
_restart.check_expression: expected is Dictionary

_restart.label_prefix: ordinary startup loads exact local cloud progress without a story seal
_restart.label_expression: "ordinary startup loads exact local cloud progress without a story seal"
_restart.check_expression: campaign.records.is_empty() and campaign.unlocked==2 and campaign.cloud_owner=="1" and not campaign.has_story_seal("level1")

_restart.label_prefix: ordinary startup has no pending writer or shared cloud apply
_restart.label_expression: "ordinary startup has no pending writer or shared cloud apply"
_restart.check_expression: not campaign.persistence_busy() and not cloud.shared_profile_pending() and not cloud._applying

_restart.label_prefix: ordinary SDK disabled startup has no attached account or active run
_restart.label_expression: "ordinary SDK disabled startup has no attached account or active run"
_restart.check_expression: not steam.available and steam._active_run==0 and not cloud.cloud_ready and cloud._owner.is_empty()

_restart.label_prefix: ordinary startup neither recovers a terminal nor creates Battle presentation
_restart.label_expression: "ordinary startup neither recovers a terminal nor creates Battle presentation"
_restart.check_expression: flow.last_result=={"ok":true,"startup_checked":true,"progress_recovered":0,"settlement_authorized":false} and flow._campaign_completion.is_empty() and current_scene.scene_file_path=="res://scenes/menu.tscn"

_restart.label_prefix: ordinary restart fresh load keeps original final public CFG bytes
_restart.label_expression: "ordinary restart fresh load keeps original final public CFG bytes"
_restart.check_expression: FileAccess.get_sha256("user://campaign.cfg")==evidence.cfg_sha256 and cfg.load("user://campaign.cfg")==OK

_restart.label_prefix: whole restart typed CFG projection matches original including unknown keys
_restart.label_expression: "whole restart typed CFG projection matches original including unknown keys"
_restart.check_expression: projected.get("ok",false) and projected.sections==expected

_restart.label_prefix: ordinary restart retains exactly two nonempty CFG journal originals
_restart.label_expression: "ordinary restart retains exactly two nonempty CFG journal originals"
_restart.check_expression: journals.size()==2 and journals.values().all(func(value):return Intent.hex(value,64))

_restart.label_prefix: ordinary restart has empty candidate stage and no terminal lifecycle files
_restart.label_expression: "ordinary restart has empty candidate stage and no terminal lifecycle files"
_restart.check_expression: _empty_cloud_stage() and _no_terminal_files()

_restart.label_prefix: same loaded production objects retain progress across ordinary frames
_restart.label_expression: "same loaded production objects retain progress across ordinary frames"
_restart.check_expression: campaign.get_instance_id()==campaign_id and cloud.get_instance_id()==cloud_id and campaign.records.is_empty() and campaign.unlocked==2 and campaign.cloud_owner=="1"

_restart.label_prefix: ordinary restart frames do not replay CFG or create terminal records
_restart.label_expression: "ordinary restart frames do not replay CFG or create terminal records"
_restart.check_expression: FileAccess.get_sha256("user://campaign.cfg")==evidence.cfg_sha256 and _cloud_journal_files()==journals and _empty_cloud_stage() and _no_terminal_files()

_restart.label_prefix: ordinary restart remains idle with settlement denied and gate open
_restart.label_expression: "ordinary restart remains idle with settlement denied and gate open"
_restart.check_expression: flow.phase==flow.Phase.IDLE and flow.last_result=={"ok":true,"startup_checked":true,"progress_recovered":0,"settlement_authorized":false} and flow._campaign_completion.is_empty() and Gate.background_allowed()

_restart.label_prefix: ordinary frames create no cloud pending upload revision or SDK run
_restart.label_expression: "ordinary frames create no cloud pending upload revision or SDK run"
_restart.check_expression: not campaign.persistence_busy() and not cloud.shared_profile_pending() and not cloud._applying and cloud.dirty==original_cloud.dirty and cloud._pending_upload==original_cloud.pending_upload and cloud._revision==original_cloud.revision and not steam.available and steam._active_run==0 and not cloud.cloud_ready and cloud._owner.is_empty()

_restart.label_prefix: original preceding cloud report unchanged after ordinary frames
_restart.label_expression: "original preceding cloud report unchanged after ordinary frames"
_restart.check_expression: FileAccess.get_sha256(path)==digest
